units.source_text: 我们两人请假数小时，穿上草黄色的裤子，打上绑腿，戴着临济学院中学的制帽，从大殿走了出来。

en.t: The two of us took several hours of leave, put on grass-yellow trousers, wrapped our leggings, and, wearing the school caps of Rinzai Gakuin Middle School, came out from the main hall.

units.source_text: 夏日阳光炎热，没有一个游人。

en.t: The summer sunlight was scorching, and there was not a single visitor.
